actors.name: Javier Milei

Nationally, he is navigating security concerns following arrests over online death threats against him, while preparing for an official visit by Pope Leo XIV.

actors.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
actors.blurb: Flávio Bolsonaro is at the center of growing legal and political scrutiny following his travel to the United States, prompting a US Congressman to formally request his immediate deportation over money laundering allegations. In response, his legal team in Brazil has filed petitions with the Supreme Federal Court to recover his confiscated passport and disqualify the investigating judge.
